_comment: Tunable weights and remediation costs for path ranking and the minimum cut (Phase 5). Editable by hand â€” the whole point is that a reviewer can recompute any score with a calculator. Scores normalise to 0-10.

score_weights._comment: Handbook factors. A path's raw score is the sum of the factors that apply; then normalised to 10 by dividing by the max achievable and x10.

short_path._comment: short_path_bonus is scaled: a 2-hop path gets the full bonus, longer paths less, down to 0 at max_hops. bonus * (max_hops - hops) / (max_hops - 2).

sensitive_data._comment: What marks a data store (S3 bucket, RDS instance) as a SENSITIVE_DATA sink — reaching CAN_READ/CAN_WRITE to it is a path. Reading a tag/ARN is config, not judgment. tag_match: any tag whose key (case-insensitive) is in tag_keys and whose value (lowercased) is in tag_values. arns: explicit resource ARNs always treated as sensitive.

remediation_costs._comment: Cost to cut each edge type = disruption of the fix, 1 (trivial) to 10 (removes real access). null = uncuttable (never proposed as a cut). Used as edge capacity in the minimum cut and as the denominator in best-single-fix ranking.

remediation_fixes._comment: Plain-English fix per edge type, shown next to the cut. Phase 8 turns the chosen cut into an actual Terraform patch.
remediation_fixes.CAN_REACH: restrict the security group / remove the public IP so the internet cannot reach it
remediation_fixes.CONTAINS_CREDENTIAL: rotate the exposed key and remove it from the object
remediation_fixes.CAN_READ: scope the identity/bucket policy so this principal can no longer read it
remediation_fixes.CAN_WRITE: scope the policy so this principal can no longer modify it
remediation_fixes.GRANTS_ADMIN: scope the admin-equivalent action to specific resources, or detach the policy
remediation_fixes.CAN_LAUNCH_AS: remove PassRole or the compute permission so the role cannot be launched
remediation_fixes.CAN_ASSUME: tighten the role trust policy so this principal cannot assume it
remediation_fixes.HAS_INSTANCE_PROFILE: detach the over-privileged role from the instance profile
remediation_fixes.CONTAINS_ROLE: remove the powerful role from the instance profile
remediation_fixes.EXECUTES_AS: give the function a least-privilege execution role
remediation_fixes.HAS_ATTACHED: detach or scope down the policy
remediation_fixes.IN_GROUP: remove the user from the group
remediation_fixes.CAN_TAKE_OVER: scope iam:CreateAccessKey / Create|UpdateLoginProfile to the caller's own user (arn:aws:iam::<acct>:user/${aws:username})
remediation_fixes.CAN_JOIN_GROUP: remove iam:AddUserToGroup, or scope it away from privileged groups
remediation_fixes.CAN_REWRITE_TRUST: remove iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy on this role, or scope it to roles the caller owns
